units.text: Ashwood Dunes Reforestation Event Join us for a meaningful morning at the annual Ashwood Dunes Reforestation.
Volunteers will plant native tree seedlings to help restore the local environment.
No special skills required, feel free to join us.
When and Where
• September 5th, 2026, 8 a.m.-11 a.m.
• Ashwood Dunes Wilderness Participation Fee: Free Rewards: All participants will get a commemorative badge.
• Plant 5 trees: Receive a reusable water bottle
• Plant 10 or more trees: Receive a Tshirt Registration: Online registration is encouraged, but onsite signups will be available on the day of the event.
Event Guidelines
• Bring a hat and gloves; shovels and water will be prepared.
• Follow instructions from the event staff.
For more information, please visit www.ashwooddunes.com.

units.text: 2026 Footnote Dance Program The 2026 Footnote Dance Program is a modern dance program created for youth aged 13-18.
When: Wednesday, October 21st-Friday, October 23rd (5 p.m.-8 p.m. each day) Where: Footnote Studio, 70 Elm Street Cost: $50 per workshop, or $120 for all three workshops Workshop Schedule
• [Day 1] Dance Lesson: Build creative confidence through guided movement exercises.
• [Day 2] Performance Practice: Refine your performance skills and learn to connect with your audience.
• [Day 3] Open Studio: Friends and family are invited to see what participants have created!
Information
• A free shuttle bus service will be provided for all participants and visitors.
• Preregistration is required.
